name: Frontend UI Layer
description: React components, pages, and the app shell (App.jsx, main.jsx, index.html) that render the chat, auth, and document-selection screens, plus their co-located CSS.

name: Frontend Data & State Layer
description: Custom hooks, repository-pattern data access modules, the shared API client, and the auth context that mediate between UI components and the backend.

name: Backend API & Auth Layer
description: FastAPI routers exposing auth, chat, conversation, and document endpoints, together with the JWT/password security utilities that gate them.

name: Agentic RAG Pipeline
description: The LangGraph state machine (rewrite, hybrid retrieve/rerank, grade, retry, generate, faithfulness-check nodes) that powers document chat.

name: Backend Service & Jobs Layer
description: Ingestion and OCR-client business logic, Celery worker/task definitions for background processing, and administrative CLI scripts.

name: Data Layer
description: SQLAlchemy ORM models, Pydantic schemas, the DB session/engine setup, Alembic migrations, and the users table definition backing pgvector-based storage.

name: Test & Evaluation Layer
description: The pytest suite covering auth, chat, ingestion, RAG graph/nodes/retrieval, and uploads, plus the golden-set evaluation harness for the RAG pipeline.

name: OCR Microservice
description: The standalone PaddleOCR FastAPI microservice deployed as its own container, invoked by the backend's ingestion pipeline.

name: Infrastructure & Configuration
description: Dockerfiles, docker-compose service definitions, nginx config, build/lint tooling, environment templates, and app-factory/settings code that assemble and deploy the three services.

name: Documentation & Planning
description: Project docs (README, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md), architecture/spec write-ups, feature-planning notes, and brainstorming artifacts covering upload, chat, RAG, and login features.
